title: 第7章 说好的炮灰呢第8章 仙帝约我切磋
slug: 穿越庶长兄嫡弟竟是仙帝转世
content_zh:
空气凝滞。
云擎端着汤碗的手稳如磐石，那针对性的煌阳威压临近他身前时，竟如同泥牛入海，被包容万物的混沌气息悄然化去。
他没被这突如其来的斥责激怒，那双重瞳平静地抬起，穿透云煌周身狂暴的能量乱流。以重瞳之能，他看得总能比旁人更多一些。
怒火、挫败、焦躁，以及一丝连主人都未察觉的，懊恼？
云擎了然，这位少君，与其说是因阵法受挫迁怒，倒不如说是在别扭。
在云煌冰冷的注视下，云擎不退反进，端着汤碗上前。
随后抬起空着的左手，指尖灵力微凝，轻点向上方黯淡的阵盘。
“少君，”他温和依旧，像是方才那番冷言冷语根本没落进耳中，“这里的衔接，似乎太刚硬了一些。”
“星璇与辰枢本该一气相承，若只一味求刚，反而容易在最后关头失衡。烈阳固然炽盛，可真正运转起来，也未必全无回旋余地。刚极易折，不若尝试以三分柔力注入，仿若潮汐引力，或许……”
说话间，云擎指尖在虚空中勾勒，带着混沌特性的灵力丝线融入阵盘虚影。
原本死寂的阵盘轻轻一颤，原本彼此相冲的几处符文，竟真稳住了一瞬。虽还远远不到成阵的地步，但那僵局，已被点开。
云煌眸光微凝，视线立刻落回阵盘之上。他天资绝世，一点即透，瞬间便明白了关键所在。这困扰他数日的难题，竟被云擎如此轻描淡写地指出了关窍。
而更让他一时说不出话的，是云擎的态度，对方到底维护了他的颜面。
云煌沉默了片刻，今日实在是有失体面。
“你……”
云擎依旧微笑，见他怒气稍缓，这才将那碗冰心镇魂汤放到案边，温声道：“阵法耗神，少君先稳一稳心神，再继续也不迟。破题之法已现，稍作调息，必能功成。”
云煌看着那碗汤，又看看云擎，终究是端起来一饮而尽，原本躁动的识海慢慢平复下来。
放下碗，云煌复杂地看了云擎一眼，忽然开口，声音少了几分冰冷：“你于阵法一道，倒是有些眼力。”
“不过是仗着这双眼睛，看得比旁人细些罢了。“云擎神态自然，一双重瞳笑眼弯弯，透着一丝罕见的调侃。
云煌看着他，眸光微动，随后匆忙将注意力投向阵图，依照云擎的指点开始推演，果然顺畅了许多。

……
待云煌推演完最后一处，殿外已是星斗满天，灵雾漫过栖梧殿的鎏金脊顶，将夜色衬得愈发静谧。
云擎躬身行礼，衣衫下摆扫过殿内玉砖：“少君，若暂无其他吩咐，擎便先行告退了。”
云煌未抬眸，指尖把玩着一缕煌阳灵气，淡淡开口：“静心院已为你备好，这一月，昼夜随侍，听候传唤。”
“这……”
素来从容不迫的云擎难得一顿。
静心院坐落于栖梧殿群东后方，是处独立雅致的小院，云氏戒鞭的主材“清心藤”，便有不少栽种在此处。
关键是，此地距云煌的寝居不过百余步。
content_en:
The air is stagnant.
Yun Qing's hand holding the soup bowl was as steady as a rock. When the targeted pressure of the bright sun approached him, it was like a mud cow entering the sea, being quietly melted away by the chaotic atmosphere that encompassed all things.
He was not angered by the sudden rebuke, and his double pupils calmly raised, penetrating the violent energy flow around Yunhuang. With his double eyes, he can always see more than others.
Anger, frustration, impatience, and a hint of annoyance that even the owner is unaware of?
Yun Qing understood that this young gentleman was not so much angry because of the setback of the formation as he was awkward.
Under Yun Huang's cold gaze, Yun Qing stepped forward instead of retreating, holding the soup bowl and stepping forward.
Then he raised his free left hand, his fingertips slightly condensed with spiritual power, and he tapped the dim array plate above.
"Young Master," he remained gentle, as if the sarcastic remarks just now did not fall into his ears at all, "the connection here seems to be too rigid."
"Xingxuan and Chenshu are supposed to be one and the same, but if they only pursue rigidity, they will easily become unbalanced at the last moment. Although the sun is blazing, it may not have any room for maneuver when it really starts to move. Hardness is extremely easy to break, so why not try to inject three-thirds of soft power, like the gravity of the tide, maybe..."
As he spoke, Yun Qing traced his fingertips in the void, and the spiritual power threads with chaotic characteristics merged into the shadow of the array.
The originally dead formation disk trembled slightly, and the runes that were originally in conflict with each other actually stabilized for a moment. Although it is still far from forming a formation, the deadlock has been broken.
Yunhuang's eyes narrowed slightly, and his gaze immediately fell back to the formation disk. He is extremely talented, and he understands the key points instantly. Yun Qing pointed out the key point of this problem that had troubled him for several days in such an understatement.
What made him even more speechless for a moment was Yun Qing's attitude. After all, the other party had protected his face.
Yunhuang was silent for a moment. Today was really unseemly.
"You..."
Yun Qing was still smiling. Seeing that his anger had subsided a little, he put the bowl of Bing Xin Soul Soothing Soup beside the table and said warmly: "The formation consumes energy. Young Master, please calm down your mind first before continuing. The method to solve the problem has been discovered. With a little adjustment of your breath, you will definitely succeed."
Yunhuang looked at the bowl of soup, then at Yun Qing, and finally picked it up and drank it all in one gulp. His restless consciousness slowly calmed down.
Putting down the bowl, Yun Huang glanced at Yun Qing complicatedly, and suddenly spoke, his voice less cold: "You have some good eyesight when it comes to formations."
"It's just that with these eyes, I can see more clearly than others." Yun Qing's expression was natural, with a double pair of pupils and smiling eyes, showing a rare hint of ridicule.
Yun Huang looked at him, his eyes moved slightly, and then he hurriedly turned his attention to the array diagram and started to deduce according to Yun Qing's instructions. It turned out to be much smoother.
…
By the time Yunhuang finished deducing the last part, the sky outside the palace was already full of stars, and the spiritual mist spread over the gilded ridge top of Qiwu Palace, making the night even more tranquil.
Yun Qing bowed in salute and swept the hem of his clothes across the jade bricks in the hall: "Young Master, if you have no other instructions for now, Qing will leave first."
Before Yun Huang raised his eyes, he played with a ray of radiant spiritual energy with his fingertips and said lightly: "The Jingxin Courtyard has been prepared for you. This month, you will be here day and night, waiting for summons."
"This..."
Yun Qing, who had always been calm and unhurried, had a rare meal.
The Jingxin Courtyard is located in the east and rear of the Qiwu Hall Group. It is an independent and elegant small courtyard. Many of the "Qingxin Vine", the main material of the Yun family's ring whip, is planted here.
The key is that this place is only a hundred steps away from Yunhuang's residence.
